notes: Real gameplay code on real players; the recorder presses buttons and moves the camera. Staging is listed in the recorder's header. GIFs carry a control caption bottom-left; the MP4s are clean (no captions, no audio, H.264 yuv420p, no B-frames, first frame at t = 0, frame n at n/30 s). The only HUD in any frame is the mark badge and timing ring in the marking demo.

demos.name: marking
demos.ground: bush oval (Field 2, Settings.FieldStyle.OVAL_1), centre circle, match sun
demos.what_it_shows: Three takes with the mark badge and timing ring over the marker. 0.0 s Safe mark on the chest (caught at 1.37 s). 3.0 s Running mark: the marker runs onto the ball at 5.5 m/s and taps. 6.0 s Contested mark: an opponent at the marker's shoulder holds the Safe mark, the marker leaps (Aggressive) and MarkContest gives it to the marker (caught at 7.37 s).

takes.caption: CONTESTED MARK · tap Y to leap

demos.controls: Safe: hold A (G). Running: tap X (Q). Aggressive: tap Y (H).
demos.check: The run logged a mark for takes 1 and 3. It logged nothing for the Running take, so check by eye that the ball is taken in take 2.

demos.name: tackling
demos.ground: bush oval (Field 2), centre circle, match sun
demos.what_it_shows: Three takes, the carrier running at 4 m/s in the first two. 0.0 s Wrap (tap X): lands at 0.84 s, b 0.98, held; the carrier goes down on the active ragdoll and the tackler keeps their feet (outcome 'fall', not the both-go-down wrap). 3.6 s Sling (hold B): lands at 4.5 s, b 0.98, held; the carrier is slung to the ground on the ragdoll, the tackler stays up. 7.2 s Fend-off: the carrier taps RB at 8.57 s as a tackler steps in from 60 degrees off their line; the tackle's b is cut from 0.28 to 0.18, p(break) 0.82 is past the fended threshold 0.5, the tackle breaks and the carrier runs on with the ball. Without the fend that tackle would have held (p(break) 0.72 against the sling's 0.95).

takes.caption: FEND OFF · tap RB with the ball

demos.controls: Wrap: tap X (Q). Sling: hold B (E). Fend off: tap RB (J) while carrying.

demos.name: ruck
demos.ground: park (Field 1, Settings.FieldStyle.CLASSIC), centre circle, match sun
demos.what_it_shows: Two ball-ups in the centre circle with the ground's field umpire throwing the ball up. 0.0 s: the HOME ruckman presses RB early, the press is held to the toss's peak and connects at 2.24 s, tapping toward a HOME runner who gathers it at 3.47 s and runs on; the AWAY ruckman presses late and misses. 5.6 s: the other way round, AWAY connects at 7.83 s and HOME misses.

takes.caption: CENTRE BOUNCE · RB to hit out, right stick to aim
A PALM, NOT A CATCH · early press, tapped at the peak

demos.controls: Hit-out: RB (J). Aim the tap: right stick (arrow keys).

demos.name: kicking
demos.ground: park (Field 1), centre circle then 36 m out from the +X goal, match sun
demos.what_it_shows: 0.0 s Stance: the kicker jogs in and holds the stance, the predicted flight drawn to its landing ring, power raised from 0.55 to 0.8. 2.9 s Drop punt, side-on and close: ball drop, straight leg, pointed foot, then the ball climbing away. 5.4 s Set shot: a 22 m kick is marked (Safe, legal) at 6.77 s, 36 m from goal; the kicker walks back, lines up (Y) at 7.67 s, runs in and kicks; the ball crosses the goal line between the big posts (z -0.02 m, posts at ±3.2 m) at 13.57 s.

takes.caption: KICK · hold LT to aim and set the power
SET SHOT · Y to line up, RT to run in and kick

demos.controls: Stance: hold LT (right mouse / K). Kick: RT (left mouse / F). Line up a set shot: Y (X key).
demos.check: The set shot crossed the line 0.8 m off the ground, so it may have bounced through; check by eye before calling it a goal on the full.

changed_facts.was: Demos recorded in the animation viewer's dark studio
changed_facts.now: Recorded on the game's own grounds (bush oval and park) under the match sun, clean frame

changed_facts.was: Demo GIFs 720x405 at about 15 fps; kicking 3.4 s
changed_facts.now: GIFs 640x360 at 20 fps, 9.2-14.4 s; MP4s 1600x900 at 30 fps

changed_facts.was: Tackling demo: wrap, sling, hit stick
changed_facts.now: Tackling demo: wrap, sling, fend-off (the hit stick is still in the game and the README table, just not in the demo)

Fend off: RB (J) while carrying, a straight arm for 0.45 s; a tackle landing in it from inside 100 degrees of the carrier's facing has b cut by 35%; a fended sling is judged on 0.5 instead of 0.95; a broken tackler is shoved back at 2 m/s; evaluated, never rolled
changed_facts.source: scripts/tuning.gd FEND_DURATION, FEND_ARC_DEG, FEND_B_CUT, FEND_PUSH_SPEED; player_controller.gd fend_impact, _try_tackle

changed_facts.now: Fist: RB (J) in a mark contest, the ruck tap's leap then a punch at 9 m/s (2 m/s up)

changed_facts.was: A contested mark was whoever's hands got there (timing sets reach)
changed_facts.now: Contested marks: every player going for the ball is rated on timing, position, hand height and body; only the highest-rated player's hands close; hand-set weights, evaluated not rolled

Optional mark-timing assist, off by default (Settings > HUD STYLE > MARKING): game slows to 0.4x from 0.6 s before the press instant, with a height-against-time graph over the player; doesn't change how a mark is judged

changed_facts.was: Only a human's tackle or bump starts a ragdoll; AI tackles play clips
changed_facts.now: The AI's sling tackle goes on the ragdoll too, against a human or another AI player

changed_facts.was: The hit-out 'knocks' the ball (no speed given)
changed_facts.now: The hit-out sets the ball's velocity off the palm: 6 m/s flat plus 1.5 m/s of lift, first landing about 6 m away
Hold LB (L) while kicking: aimed 45 degrees or more across the body is a snap, otherwise a banana that bends the other way
D-pad left, or a tap of LB on defence

unchanged_and_checked: Three marks: Safe hold A, Running tap X, Aggressive tap Y; reach 1.2 / 1.0 / 1.1 m; Running window 0.25 s; Safe plant 0.3 s; legal mark after 15 m; 7.5 m walk back (scripts/tuning.gd MARK_*_REACH_SCALE, MARK_RUNNING_CATCH_WINDOW, MARK_SAFE_PLANT_TIME, MARK_STAND_MIN_DISTANCE, MARK_RETREAT_DISTANCE)
Timing ring timed from the ball's real flight (PlayerController.mark_timing_offset; MARK_CUE_SOURCE = 1, GATED)
Drop punt 13-24 m/s with backspin; hip-fire 20 degrees of scatter; set shot inside 55 m (KICK_MIN_SPEED, KICK_MAX_SPEED, KICK_HIP_FIRE_SPREAD_DEG, GOAL_SET_SHOT_MAX_DISTANCE)
Two ruckmen, 2 s window, a palm not a catch (RUCK_CONTEST_WINDOW; _resolve_hit_out)

Tackle thresholds wrap 0.5, sling 0.95; prior opportunity 0.5 s; lunge reach 2.2 m; bump within 5 m of the ball (TACKLE_LUNGE_BREAK_P, TACKLE_SLIDE_BREAK_P, PRIOR_OPPORTUNITY_GRACE, TACKLE_LUNGE_REACH, CONTEST_BUMP_BALL_RADIUS)
The officiating signal snippet (holding_the_ball_called / field_ball_up_called) still matches player_controller.gd
